title: Salalah Tour Package from Dubai - 4 days
highlights: Stay in a 2-bedroom villa at Samharam Resort.
Visit Mughsail Beach, Wadi Darbat and Jebel Samhan.
Witness Marneef Cave and its springing water.
Experience the Anti-Gravity Point and Sinkhole.
Explore Haffa Souq and the Omani market.
Enjoy private transfers in a Toyota Prado with a dedicated driver-guide.
Experience a blend of nature, adventure and culture.
overview: This exclusive three-night, four-day Salalah tour from Dubai offers a perfect blend of nature, adventure and cultural experiences. Explore pristine beaches, hidden waterfalls, lush wadis and breathtaking viewpoints while enjoying a private tour with a dedicated guide. The package includes comfortable accommodation, private transfers and carefully curated excursions for an enriching Salalah escape.

sections.title: Salalah Nature and Culture Escape
paragraphs: Enjoy a 2-bedroom villa at Samharam Resort, private transfers and a Toyota Prado with a dedicated driver-guide.
Discover Salalah’s beaches, waterfalls, wadis, viewpoints, sinkhole, local market and cultural attractions in a seamless four-day journey.

itinerary.title: Departure from UAE
description: Evening pick-up from your location in Dubai or Sharjah.
Begin the overnight journey to Salalah.

itinerary.title: Arrival and Coastal Wonders
itinerary.description: Arrive in Salalah and explore coastal highlights including Mughsail Beach, Marneef Cave and its springing water.

itinerary.title: Nature and Adventure
itinerary.description: Discover Wadi Darbat, Jebel Samhan, the Anti-Gravity Point and the famous sinkhole while enjoying Salalah’s natural scenery.

itinerary.title: Cultural and Shopping Experience
itinerary.description: Visit Haffa Souq and the Omani market for local shopping before concluding the journey.

included: Private transfers in a Toyota Prado.
All activities are private unless stated otherwise.
excluded: Transfers not included in the itinerary.
goodToKnow: The best time to visit is June–September during the Khareef season for lush greenery and waterfalls.
The currency is the Omani Rial (OMR), but AED is widely accepted.
Weather varies from warm to cool, especially in the mountains.
Dress modestly when visiting cultural and religious sites.
SIM cards are available at the airport and Wi-Fi is available at the hotel.
